evidence.quote: The program is based on 210 ECTS and is divided into three major component.
The International Business programme at TH Nürnberg is a seven-semester course, awarding 210 ECTS credits.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,000 EUR
For the winter semester: 2 May 2027 to 15 July 2027

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page explicitly states 1,000 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants; the university's central page (Studiengebühren für Internationale Studierende aus Nicht-EWR-Ländern) confirms 1.000,00 Euro pro Semester for new international students from non-EEA countries, but it is a general institution-wide rule, so the programme-specific DAAD statement was used. Application channel: the programme's own pages do not mention uni-assist; the admission-process page indicates direct application to the university (documents by post to Student Services, application cover page). The supplied pages do not show a confirmation of the route in the university portal, so this is the best-supported option; verify. Documents: the pages supply no document list for this programme, so no documents fact was output. Deadlines: DAAD gives the period for all countries; the university page gives an equivalent period for 2027 (2 May 2027 to 15 July 2027), used for the intake dates.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEIC: 785 Reading: 450 Listening: 485 PTE Academic: 75 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 94 IELTS Academic: 6.5 Cambridge English Qualifications: C1 Advanced

note.fr: Admission compétitive (numerus clausus) : la sélection se fait sur la moyenne finale de votre diplôme d'accès à l'université (p. ex. baccalauréat).
note.en: Competitive admission (numerus clausus): selection is based on the final average grade of your university entrance qualification (e.g. school-leaving certificate).

evidence.quote: The International Business programme is a numerus clausus (NC) programme with a competitive selection process due to limited places.
Admission is based on the final average grade of your university entrance qualification (e.g. school-leaving certificate or prior studies).

note.fr: Vérifiez la procédure de candidature exacte (portail/plateforme) sur le site de l'université : les documents sont envoyés par la poste au Student Services.
note.en: Check the exact application procedure (portal/platform) on the university website: documents are sent by post to Student Services.
